name: reminder
title: Process: sending a reminder
purpose: A model of an irreversible send. The text must leave once, and the report must say only what is proven.

states.meaning: The request is accepted, nothing is recorded
The intent is recorded durably and will be visible after a restart
The request went to the provider, the outcome is unknown
The provider accepted the request, delivery is not proven
The text is found in the recipient's feed
Accepted, but there is no proof; a person checks by hand
The intent is already recorded: the text may have left; a repeat is forbidden, a person checks by hand

transitions.when: The provider is not in the config
This reminder already has a record
The text is found in the feed
Time ran out, the text is not in the feed
